text: The decision gate records a proposal before returning its verdict.
A committed receipt represents a database transaction that has completed.
Tool proposals are normalized before policy evaluation.
The trajectory chain links each event to the previous event digest.
The IPC client rejects a response whose nonce does not match the request.
A provider signature covers the canonical request digest and both nonces.
A policy rule has a stable identifier and an explicit action.
Unknown policy fields cause configuration loading to fail.
The SQLite writer serializes event batches through one connection.
A failed SEED connection produces a durable veto.
The command parser applies a maximum request size before deserialization.
An event hash is calculated from canonical event fields and its parent hash.
The provider loads its signing credential from an inherited file descriptor.
Socket peer credentials are checked against the configured service UID.
The keyring rejects duplicate key identifiers.
An expired retiring public key cannot verify a new response.
A malformed digest is rejected before it reaches the verifier.
The workspace uses Rust 2024 edition and a shared lint configuration.
The parser returns a typed error when a required field is absent.
A unit test uses a temporary directory for filesystem fixtures.
A borrowed string slice does not require allocating a new String.
The Result enum represents either a successful value or an error.
A match expression must handle every possible enum variant.
An iterator adapter can transform items before they are collected.
An immutable reference permits reading a value without taking ownership.
